ipe-rosa.note: Comércio's named landscape colour. Its only role (--role-commerce) is declared but not painted on the site; the site shows ipe-rosa-text and ipe-rosa-tint.

display.purpose: The greeting on the home's sky ("Bom dia, Dourados"): two lines on phones, one from 760px.

headline.displayName: Headline · the page on the sky
headline.purpose: The page's name on the sky; at 800 also "Em breve", the month's title and Comércio's letters.

date.purpose: Dates in NOS's voice, with tabular figures: the home's circled date.

title.purpose: Day heads at 750 with tabular figures; 750 also for the panel's day, business names, empty-state titles, the month's numerals; 700 for the doors' names.

activity-lead.purpose: An activity's title in the panel (Inter: the organization's own words).

activity.purpose: An activity's title on its card and on the home's phone card.

body.purpose: Reading text; descriptions at 0.9375rem/1.5; hints held to 34–36ch.

meta.purpose: The organization and the place under an activity, in the soft ink; the time row above is 600 at 0.9375rem in ink.

button.purpose: Buttons; chips and segments 500 at 0.9375rem (600 chosen); tags and the phone bar 500 at 0.8125rem; month weekday heads 600 0.75rem 0.04em uppercase.

shadows.name: day-rest
shadows.value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, #4A2212 8%, transparent), 0 6px 16px color-mix(in srgb, #4A2212 7%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Cards at rest by day: activity cards, the month, the home's next card, the desk panel, business and information cards, the message bubble.

shadows.name: night-rest
shadows.purpose: The same surfaces at night: no shadow, a 1px terra roxa line draws the edge (not `none`: lists add rings to it).

shadows.name: sheet-day
shadows.purpose: The bottom sheet over its scrim (the ink at 50%).

shadows.name: sheet-night
shadows.purpose: The only shadow at night: the bottom sheet over its scrim (Night Shade at 70%).

shadows.name: selection-ring
shadows.purpose: The quiet mark of selection, added to the rest shadow (the activity open in the panel) or inset (the month's chosen day).

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: The strong mark of focus: Deep Urucum by day, Night Urucum at night, the sky's ink on the sky.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The sheet's slide and the sun's rise.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background, colour, border and shadow changes on hover and state: buttons, chips, segments, cards, doors, the nav pill.

motion.name: sheet
motion.purpose: The bottom sheet slides up and away; while dragged it follows the finger with no transition.

motion.name: sun-rise
motion.purpose: The one authored motion: the home's sun rises a little when the page opens; only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce every transition and animation stops.

breakpoints.name: narrowest
breakpoints.purpose: 259px at 16px (zoomed phones): the send button drops its icon.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: 359px at 16px (small phones, 200% zoom, large default fonts): 12px gutters, smaller greeting and page name, one column of doors.

breakpoints.name: wide-phone
breakpoints.purpose: 24px gutters; the bottom sheet centred at 560px.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: The links on the sky (no bar at the foot), the page's name under them, the home's actions and "Também na agenda", Comércio's rows.

breakpoints.name: desk
breakpoints.purpose: Two columns: the agenda with its 380px panel, the home's calm desk, Comércio's information card; 32px gutters.

breakpoints.name: desk-wide
breakpoints.purpose: The panel at 420px; the month writes its entries in.

breakpoints.name: short-phone
breakpoints.purpose: Panfleto scrolls its format bar to the top; the preview takes the title's room.

breakpoints.name: phone-landscape
breakpoints.value: max-width: 1099px and max-height: 500px and orientation: landscape
breakpoints.purpose: The sheet takes nearly the whole height; the flyer stands beside its controls.

breakpoints.name: short-desk
breakpoints.purpose: Flyer mode also folds the organization and the hint.

light.--role-card-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-earth-shadow) 8%, transparent), 0 6px 16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-earth-shadow) 7%, transparent)

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action, in urucum: sending an activity to WhatsApp. Night Urucum with terra roxa text in the dark theme.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-accent" type="button"><svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7.9 20A9 9 0 1 0 4 16.1L2 22Z"/></svg>Enviar no WhatsApp</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--role-accent, #C2410C); color: var(--role-on-accent, #FFFFFF); font: 600 0.9375rem/1.2 var(--font-ui, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-accent .ds-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: var(--role-accent-hover, color-mix(in srgb, #C2410C 86%, #221714)); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--role-focus, #A3360A); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: The second action beside the primary one: the card colour with a 1px line; done fills with ink.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-line { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--role-line, #E9D5C8); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--role-card, #FFFBF7); color: var(--role-ink, #221714); font: 600 0.9375rem/1.2 var(--font-ui, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-line .ds-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; } .ds-btn-line:not(.is-done):hover { border-color: var(--role-ink-soft, #6A4E44); background: var(--role-card-hover, #FFF4EC); } .ds-btn-line.is-done { border-color: var(--role-ink, #221714); background: var(--role-ink, #221714); color: var(--role-on-ink, #FFFBF7); } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--role-focus, #A3360A); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Group Chips
components.description: The agenda's group filter: 36px pills (44px tap area), each group's dot before its name; pressed fills with ink and a check takes the dot's place.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 8px; } .ds-chip { position: relative; flex: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 36px; margin: 4px 0; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--role-line, #E9D5C8); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--role-card, #FFFBF7); color: var(--role-ink, #221714); font: 500 0.9375rem/1 var(--font-ui, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-chip::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -5px 0; } .ds-chip-check { display: none; width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { padding-left: 10px; border-color: var(--role-ink, #221714); background: var(--role-ink, #221714); color: var(--role-on-ink, #FFFBF7); font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-chip-check { display: block; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-dot { display: none; } .ds-chip:not([aria-pressed="true"]):hover { background: var(--role-card-hover, #FFF4EC); border-color: var(--role-ink-soft, #6A4E44); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--role-focus, #A3360A); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dot { display: inline-block; flex: none; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--sector, var(--role-no-sector, #6A4E44)); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Lista | Mês and Mensagem | Panfleto: two equal 42px segments in a pill; the chosen one in ink with a check in place of its icon.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; max-width: 420px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--role-line, #E9D5C8); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--role-card, #FFFBF7); } .ds-seg-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--role-ink, #221714); font: 500 1rem/1.2 var(--font-ui, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-seg-tab + .ds-seg-tab { border-left: 1px solid var(--role-line, #E9D5C8); } .ds-seg-tab .ds-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-seg-tab[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--role-ink, #221714); color: var(--role-on-ink, #FFFBF7); font-weight: 600; } .ds-seg-tab:not([aria-selected="true"]):hover { background: var(--role-card-hover, #FFF4EC); } .ds-seg-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--role-focus, #A3360A); outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-seg-tab[aria-selected="true"]:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--role-on-ink, #FFFBF7); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Comércio's search: a 48px pill at 16px type (no iOS zoom), a soft icon inside, a round clear button; focus turns the line urucum.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; max-width: 400px; } .ds-search-icon { position: absolute; left: 16px; display: flex; color: var(--role-ink-soft, #6A4E44); pointer-events: none; } .ds-search-icon .ds-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; margin: 0; padding: 0 48px 0 46px; border: 1px solid var(--role-line, #E9D5C8); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--role-card, #FFFBF7); color: var(--role-ink, #221714); font: 400 1rem/1.2 var(--font-ui, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--role-ink-soft, #6A4E44); opacity: 1; } .ds-search input:not(:placeholder-shown) { font-weight: 500; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--role-focus, #A3360A); outline-offset: 0; border-color: var(--role-focus, #A3360A); } .ds-search-clear { position: absolute; right: 2px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: none; color: var(--role-ink, #221714); cursor: pointer; } .ds-search-clear .ds-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-search-clear:hover { background: var(--role-wash, color-mix(in srgb, #221714 7%, transparent)); } .ds-search-clear:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--role-focus, #A3360A); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation (phone bar)
components.description: Under 760px the pages' links run along the foot of the screen; the open page in Deep Urucum, its icon in an Urucum Tint pill. From 760px they move onto the sky.
components.html: InícioAgendaComércio
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); max-width: 390px; padding: 6px 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--role-line, #E9D5C8); background: var(--role-card, #FFFBF7); color: var(--role-ink-soft, #6A4E44); } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 52px; border-radius: 12px; color: inherit; font: 500 0.8125rem/1.38 var(--font-ui, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 56px; height: 32px; border-radius: 999px; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-nav-icon .ds-icon { width: 22px; height: 22px; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--role-accent-text, #A3360A); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] .ds-nav-icon { background: var(--role-accent-tint, #F9D9C8); } .ds-nav-link:not([aria-current="page"]):hover .ds-nav-icon { background: var(--role-fill, #F4E4D9); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--role-focus, #A3360A); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Activity Card
components.description: One activity on the land: its title beside the share mark, then when (the next one circled by hand, "a próxima"), who (the group's dot) and where. The whole card opens the panel.
components.css: .ds-event { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; max-width: 560px; padding: 14px 14px 15px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--role-card-border, transparent); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--role-card, #FFFBF7); box-shadow: var(--role-card-shadow, 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, #4A2212 8%, transparent), 0 6px 16px color-mix(in srgb, #4A2212 7%, transparent)); color: var(--role-ink, #221714); } .ds-event-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-event-title { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-share { display: grid; }

components.name: Doors
components.description: The home's way into each page: flat cards in the page's landscape tint (Agenda urucum, Comércio ipê-rosa), secondary text mixed from the hue into the ink.
components.html: Agenda4 atividades até 20/11Depois, sáb 31/10, 21h: Baile dos Educadores – Festa TropicalComércioEm breveEstamos coletando as informações e organizando antes de mostrá-las aqui.
components.css: .ds-doors { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; max-width: 390px; } .ds-door { --door-tint: var(--role-agenda-tint, #F7CDB8); --door-text: var(--role-agenda-text, #A3360A); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; padding: 12px 12px 14px 14px; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--door-tint); color: var(--role-ink, #221714); font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-door--commerce { --door-tint: var(--role-commerce-tint, #F3C8DA); --door-text: var(--role-commerce-text, #A12E5F); } .ds-door:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--door-tint) 88%, var(--door-text)); } .ds-door:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--role-focus, #A3360A); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-door-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-door-head .ds-icon { width: 22px; height: 22px; color: var(--door-text); } .ds-door-name { font: 700 1.125rem/1.33 var(--font-display, 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-door-line { font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.36; font-weight: 600; } .ds-door-text { font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.4; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--door-text) 55%, var(--role-ink, #221714)); }

narrative.overview:
NOS opens on the sky over Dourados at this hour and the land beneath it. Every page stacks the same three layers: the header is the sky of this hour, painted in five flat bands (amanhecer, dia, entardecer and noite by the clock in the light theme, always the night in the dark theme); the woven band under it is the horizon; below lies the land, light clay by day and terra roxa at night, where the activities, the doors and the businesses rest as clear rounded cards. The sun, a disc inside an urucum loop drawn by hand, rises big from behind the band and runs off the edge; at night a small moon, about a fifth of the sun, sits high among the stars.

The hand is the system's signature. The same urucum pen that draws the sun's loop and the O of the NOS mark circles the next activity and underlines today: urucum is the one marking colour, and it marks rather than fills. Each page wears one colour of the landscape on its door and its own panel (Agenda urucum, Comércio ipê-rosa); the organizations' eight groups are coloured dots. Bricolage Grotesque is NOS's voice (the greeting, dates, page titles, day heads) and Inter the reading text and the controls. The density is calm and phone-first: lists of cards with 44px targets on the phone, a production bench on the desk, never a dashboard.

The world refuses the hero banner over icon tiles, the dashboard, the grey list with thin dividers and coloured pills, the marketplace (carousels, banners, prices, ratings), and the Folhinha's notepad and torn-off sheets; nothing of the old campaign interface (the metro line to election day, the countdown, the slogan) comes back, and nothing should read as a startup, a city hall or an election campaign. Light and dark are both finished themes. The approved artboards (`design/direcao-ceu-terra-*.html`) also draw sections and a search that were deliberately not built; where they and the build diverge, the build is the reference. The flyers carry the same world into a picture: the sky of the activity's hour over the band and the land (see Components).
keyCharacteristics: Sky over land on every page, meeting at a woven horizon.
The sky in flat bands by the hour: hard stops, never a soft gradient.
One marking colour, urucum, drawn by hand: loops and strokes, not badges.
Pages in colours of the landscape; the organizations' groups as dots.
Bricolage Grotesque 800 for the voice, Inter for reading; tabular dates.
Rounded cards and standard controls: pills, circles, 18px cards.
A soft earth-tinted shadow by day, a 1px line at night.
One authored motion: the home's sun rises.

rules.name: The One Marking Colour Rule
rules.body: Urucum marks; it never fills an area. At full strength it is only the hand (the loop around the next activity, the stroke under today, the sun's loop, the mark's O), the primary button and the open page; its tints may colour the Agenda's door, the phone bar's pill, selection and the error notice. If urucum covers a panel, a header or a card on the site, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Flat Sky Rule
rules.body: The sky is five flat bands with hard stops, coloured by the hour in the light theme and always the night in the dark theme: never a soft gradient, never a photo. Text on it uses only the sky's ink and soft ink, which hold 4.5:1 or more on every band of every hour (the lowest pair is 5.05:1, the dusk's soft ink); urucum on the sky is a drawn mark, never the only sign of a state.

rules.name: The Dots, Never Shapes Rule
rules.body: A group is a coloured dot (8px; 6px in the phone month), a thin bar in the phone month, or a tinted bar with its dot on the desk month: never a shape, an icon, a filled card or a coloured pill, and never the only place the group is named (the chips and the panel say it in words). A cancelled activity keeps its group's colour as an outline.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Bricolage Grotesque is NOS speaking: the greeting, dates, page titles, day heads and the headings that file things (doors, letters, businesses). Inter is what the organizations announce and every control: an activity's title is the organization's own words and is never set in Bricolage.

rules.name: The Tabular Dates Rule
rules.body: Every date, time and count is set with tabular figures, so days and hours line up down a list.

rules.name: The Planned Flyer Rule
rules.body: A flyer sets only the faces, weights and optical size its layout engine measured (`.impeccable/flyer-metrics.html`), and every line is planned before it is drawn: the preview and the PNG are one picture. Its numerals stand alone, so they keep the font's proportional figures; dates and times in lists keep the tabular ones. A new face or weight means measuring again.

rules.name: The Sky of the Hour Rule
rules.body: A flyer's sky is the hour its activity starts, never the hour it is made, and the day's when there is no time. Its text uses the sky's inks only, and the edges between its bands never cross a line of text (only display type from 120px, which they must cross, keeps just its cap line, x-height and foot clear) nor squeeze between two lines of a block.

rules.name: The Horizon Rule
rules.body: Every page stacks the same three layers: the sky, the band (full-bleed; 16px under the inner pages' sky, 18px from 760px; 40px on the home, 44px from 760px), and the land. Only the home's next activity crosses the line: it rests on the band, the land rising 14px onto it.

rules.name: The Calm Desk Rule
rules.body: The desk adds a column, never a dashboard: the agenda's list or month beside its panel, the home's next activity beside its two doors, Comércio's list beside its information card.

rules.name: The Day Shadow, Night Line Rule
rules.body: Cards rest on the earth shadow by day and on a 1px line at night: never a shadow on the land in the dark theme, never a hard offset shadow, never a lift on hover.

rules.name: The Quiet Selection Rule
rules.body: Selection is a 1.5px soft-ink ring; focus is the strong 2px urucum ring (the sky's ink on the sky). They never trade places, and a selected card that takes focus shows both.

rules.name: The Hand Rule
rules.body: The only freehand forms are the hand's: two open pen loops (two drawings, so they don't look stamped) and a short underline on the land, in urucum at 2.5px with round caps that keep their width as they stretch to what they mark; the astro's loop on the sky, whose pen grows with the sun (3px to 6px); and the O of the mark. A loop circles only the next activity, the underline only today; never a perfect ring or a badge in their place.

rules.name: The Pills and Cards Rule
rules.body: Controls are pills or circles and containers are 18px cards (the sheet 24px at its top); no button, field or card on the land has sharp corners, except the day cells inside the month's grid.

rules.name: The Real Band Rule
rules.body: The provisional band may only be replaced by the real one: made, signed and paid for by artists of the Reserva Indígena de Dourados (Kaiowá, Guarani Ñandeva and Terena), with their visible credit in place of the provisional one. Never imitate or adapt anyone's grafismo in the meantime, and never draw a new "Indigenous" pattern to fill the band.

rules.name: The Landscape Doors Rule
rules.body: A page shows its landscape colour only as its door's tint and on its own panel ("Em breve"), with its deep shade for icons and mixed text; secondary text on a tint is the hue mixed into the ink, never a grey.

dos: Do take every colour from a role (`--role-*` in `css/theme.css`); the only literals in the stylesheets are `transparent`, `currentColor`, the band's image and system colours under forced colours.
Do finish every new surface in both themes and under all four skies, with any text on the sky in the sky's ink or soft ink (4.5:1 or more on every band).
Do keep urucum for the hand, the primary button and the open page; give a new page its own colour of the landscape as a door tint, with its deep shade for icons and mixed text.
Do show a group as its dot beside its name, so colour is never the only carrier of meaning.
Do circle the next activity and underline today with the hand marks, and nothing else on the site; on a flyer the hand circles the activity's date or day and strikes out what was cancelled.
Do set dates in Bricolage 800 with tabular figures, headings at 700–750, and what the organizations announce in Inter.
Do rest cards on the day shadow and the night line from the roles, and mark selection with the quiet soft-ink ring.
Do keep every target at 44px or more (the 36px chips carry a 44px tap area) and size text in rem.
Do credit the band as provisional in every footer while `assets/faixa.svg` is the provisional art.
donts: Don't fill a panel, a header or a card with full-strength urucum on the site, or use it for anything but marking.
Don't draw the sky with a soft gradient, a photo or a texture, or set text on it in anything but the sky's inks.
Don't give the groups shapes, icons, filled cards or coloured pills, and don't colour Comércio's categories.
Don't replace the band with an imitation or adaptation of any people's grafismo; the real band comes from artists of the Reserva Indígena de Dourados, signed, paid and credited.
Don't put shadows on the land in the dark theme, use hard offset shadows, or lift elements on hover.
Don't use the strong urucum ring for selection or the quiet ring for focus.
Don't fetch fonts from Google Fonts, or set an activity's title in Bricolage, on the site or on a flyer.
Don't add motion beyond the home's rising sun (1.6s, off under reduced motion); state changes are 0.15s colour transitions and the sheet's 0.3s slide.

Don't bring the Folhinha's devices to the site (the red header card, bindings, perforations, a yellow "Próxima") or the old campaign interface (the metro line to election day, the countdown, the slogan); nothing should read as a startup, a city hall or an election campaign.
Don't invent logos, photos, slogans, ratings or prices for the organizations or the businesses.
